explanation: Two functional defects were repaired in the llsdspi module. First, the HOTIDLE state incorrectly forced the last transmitted bit to 1 and advanced the state machine by one extra step, corrupting the serial bit order for back-to-back bytes. The fix makes the HOTIDLE path identical to the IDLE path: load the full byte, set state to START, and hold SCK high. Second, the SPI clock divider (r_z_counter) was not used to pace the bit transmission loop; the state machine toggled SCK every system clock cycle regardless of the configured divider. The fix gates the SCK toggling and state advancement in the bit-transmission branches with r_z_counter, so the SPI clock frequency respects the i_speed divider. Both changes preserve the public port interface, startup timing, and Wishbone-qualified acknowledgments.
